landing.subtitle: Private infrastructure and secure communication services
landing.desc_jitsi: Infrastructure for secure video conferences, webinars, and online meetings with end-to-end encryption (E2EE) support.
landing.desc_rocket: Private corporate messenger for secure communication, file sharing, and task coordination.
landing.desc_seafile: High-performance cloud storage for file synchronization, backups, and team collaboration.
landing.desc_vault: Self-hosted password manager. Secure storage for credentials, notes, and robust key generation.
landing.desc_yopass: Cryptographic service for secure one-time sharing of secrets and tokens with automatic destruction.
landing.desc_poste: Comprehensive mail server with integrated anti-spam filters, antivirus, and database encryption.
landing.desc_mc: Private game server for cooperative survival, building, and mod testing.
landing.desc_mumble: Low-latency voice communication server with high audio quality for team coordination.
landing.footer: © 2026 nada.mu Infrastructure. Private node. Access restricted to authorized users.
